DyPE for Anima — 动态位置外推

要求：

  • 基础型号：https://civitai.com/models/2458426/anima-official

  • 推荐：https://civitai.com/models/2540444/anima-highresaesthetic-boost

  • DyPE 节点（我的 fork）：通过 ComfyUI Manager 或 git clone 安装https://github.com/levzzz5154/ComfyUI-DyPE定制节点/ComfyUI-DyPE不再需要我的叉子了。

该分叉添加了上游尚未提供的 Anima/Cosmos 模型支持。 PR 在原始仓库中待处理 (https://github.com/wildminder/ComfyUI-DyPE).

推荐用于：1536²–2048² 世代，您希望保留构图，否则在更高的分辨率下会崩溃。适用于单个图像（DyPE 不会影响此模型的视频/序列生成）。

DyPE for Anima — Dynamic Position Extrapolation

Requirements:

  • Base model:https://civitai.com/models/2458426/anima-official

  • Recommended:https://civitai.com/models/2540444/anima-highresaesthetic-boost

  • DyPE node (my fork): Install via ComfyUI Manager or git clonehttps://github.com/levzzz5154/ComfyUI-DyPEcustom_nodes/ComfyUI-DyPEDoes NOT require my fork anymore.

The fork adds Anima/Cosmos model support not yet available in upstream. PR pending at the original repo (https://github.com/wildminder/ComfyUI-DyPE).

Recommended for: 1536²–2048² generations where you want to preserve composition that otherwise breaks down at higher resolutions. Works with single images (DyPE doesn't affect video/sequence generation for this model).
